room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year (whichever lower); modern/advanced treatments (robotic surgery, HIFU, etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability/migration credits; only declared & accepted PEDs covered after wait

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, hysterectomy etc.; 48-month wait for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy

day_care.note: Annexure C lists 383 day-care procedures; list is dynamic

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: Policy covers cost of organ under hospitalisation expenses but no explicit organ donor harvesting cover mentioned

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed cap of ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, diapers, etc.) explicitly excluded in Annexure A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (Section 10.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies separately to enhanced SI portions

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly renewal; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, gender change, cosmetic surgery

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
